column8: ["The three seat rims have uneven bright and dark sides that read as directional bevel lighting; use concentric, symmetric tones so their apparent lighting does not swing when rotated."]

["The brass links carry broad, blotchy brown shading across their faces, reading as grime rather than rubbed brass with wear confined to contact edges.","The upper-left junction merges into a dark, swollen patch where the diagonal link begins, muddying the clean one-piece connection between the seats."]

["The seat rims have bright upper edges and heavy dark lower edges, making them read as raised sidewalls under directional light; use symmetric concentric tones for a straight-down view.","The brass junction has a bright upper lip and a dark underside, so its relief depends on a lighting direction; flatten that contrast and keep wear confined to contact edges."]

["All three seats retain orange centre dots on pale clay discs, so they read as occupied sockets; remove the dots and leave the seat interiors empty and open to the board.","The seat rims and brass links have offset dark edging and uneven highlights; replace this directional relief with symmetric rim tones and evenly lit brass."]
